description: TinyClaw - Tiny memory infrastructure for AgentHLE, inspired by OpenClaw's memory system. Plain markdown files as source of truth, keyword search, and pre-compaction memory flush.

userStories.title: Configure git remotes and branches
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the repo configured with three remotes (origin, private, upstream) and a paper-experiments branch tracking private/paper-experiments.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote 'origin' points to git@github.com:yixiao-huang/agenthle-base.git
Remote 'private' points to git@github.com:yixiao-huang/agenthle-private.git
Remote 'upstream' points to git@github.com:cua-verse/agenthle-base.git
Branch 'paper-experiments' exists and tracks 'private/paper-experiments'
git remote -v shows all three remotes with correct URLs
userStories.notes: Completed. Renamed origin->upstream, added origin (fork) and private remotes, created paper-experiments branch tracking private/paper-experiments.

userStories.title: Rewrite skills SKILL.md files for AgentHLE
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SKILL.md files in skills/ rewritten to reflect AgentHLE's context instead of the Ralph project they were copied from.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -ri 'ralph' skills/ returns no matches
grep -ri 'dev-browser' skills/ returns no matches
grep -i 'AgentHLE' skills/agenthle/SKILL.md returns at least 3 matches
grep -i 'AgentHLE' skills/prd/SKILL.md returns at least 3 matches
grep -i 'evaluation\|cua\|agent' skills/agenthle/SKILL.md returns matches in example sections
grep -i 'evaluation\|cua\|agent' skills/prd/SKILL.md returns matches in example sections
userStories.notes: Completed. Both SKILL.md files rewritten for AgentHLE context with agent harness examples, CUA-relevant scenarios, and Claude-verifiable acceptance criteria.

userStories.title: MemoryStore - Markdown file storage layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a MemoryStore class that manages MEMORY.md (curated long-term) and memory_logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md (daily append-only logs) so that memory tools have a clean abstraction for reading and writing.
acceptanceCriteria: memory/store.py exists with MemoryStore class
MemoryStore.__init__ accepts a base_dir path
read_file returns content with correct line ranges; returns empty string for missing files (no exception)
append_to_daily_log creates memory_logs/ dir and file if absent, appends with timestamp
write_memory creates or overwrites MEMORY.md
search does case-insensitive substring matching across all markdown files, returns file path, line number, content, score
list_log_files returns sorted paths of existing daily log files
uv run pytest tests/test_memory_store.py passes
Lint passes (uv run ruff check .)

userStories.title: memory_search tool
userStories.description: As an agent, I want a memory_search tool so that I can search my memory files using keywords and find relevant past observations.
acceptanceCriteria: memory/tools.py exists with MemorySearchTool class extending BaseTool
MemorySearchTool registered with @register_tool('memory_search')
Accepts keywords (list of strings) and optional max_results (int) parameters
Delegates to MemoryStore.search() and returns results with file path, line number, matched content
Returns helpful message when no results found
uv run pytest tests/test_memory_tools.py::test_search passes
Lint passes (uv run ruff check .)

userStories.title: memory_get tool
userStories.description: As an agent, I want a memory_get tool so that I can read a specific memory file or line range by path, with graceful degradation on missing files.
acceptanceCriteria: memory/tools.py contains MemoryGetTool class extending BaseTool
MemoryGetTool registered with @register_tool('memory_get')
Accepts file_path (string), optional start_line and end_line (int) parameters
Restricts file_path to MEMORY.md and memory_logs/ (rejects path traversal with ..)
Returns empty string with message for missing files (no exception)
uv run pytest tests/test_memory_tools.py::test_get passes
Lint passes (uv run ruff check .)

userStories.title: MemoryFlushCallback - Pre-compaction memory save
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want a callback that periodically reminds the agent to save important observations to persistent memory, and auto-appends a summary at end of run.
acceptanceCriteria: memory/callback.py exists with MemoryFlushCallback extending AsyncCallbackHandler
Tracks step count; every flush_interval steps, appends a memory flush reminder to messages via on_llm_start
on_run_end appends a summary line to the daily log with task description and step count
Does not crash if memory_logs/ directory does not exist (creates it)
uv run pytest tests/test_memory_callback.py passes
Lint passes (uv run ruff check .)

userStories.title: Wire memory tools and callback into AgentHLEAgent
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the memory tools and callback wired into the AgentHLEAgent so that every agent run has access to memory_search, memory_get, and the flush callback.
acceptanceCriteria: agenthle_agent.py imports MemoryStore, MemorySearchTool, MemoryGetTool, MemoryFlushCallback from memory package
perform_task creates MemoryStore pointed at the project root
MemorySearchTool and MemoryGetTool added to ComputerAgent tools= list
MemoryFlushCallback registered as a callback
Agent instructions mention available memory tools
uv run python -c 'from memory import MemoryStore, MemorySearchTool, MemoryGetTool' succeeds
Lint passes (uv run ruff check .)
